programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnura berbohong dengan Fariz yang bengkak di kepalanya akiat terhantuk pada sinki. Dalam waktu yang sama, Rohana mendakwa Ainnura sengaja menolaknya sehinggakan dia hampir terjatuh. Fateha menyokong kata-kata Rohana, menyebabkan Fariz keliru siapakah yang benar di antara isteri dan ibunya. Ainnura bangkit mempertahankan haknya. Selain daripada Ainnura, Fawwaz turut menjadi mangsa Rohana dan Fateha dengan pelbagai penghinaan sehingga akhirnya kerana tidak sanggup melihat Fawwaz dihina, Fazira mengakui yang Fawwaz adalah anaknya.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Fateha dan Rohana terkejut apabila mengetahui Fawwaz adalah anak Fazira hasil hubungan terlarang dengan Raja Azali iaitu kekasih Fateha. Pada mulanya mereka tidak percaya tetapi ketika mereka hendak mendapatkan penjelasan daripada Raja Azali, Raja Azali telah ditangkap polis atas beberapa tuduhan merogol. Fariz meminta maaf di atas sikap Rohana selama ini. Ainnura telah lama memaafkan Rohana tetapi mahu Fariz menceraikannya kerana dia tidak mahu Fariz menjadi anak derhaka gara-garanya. Rohana terharu dengan sikap baik Ainnura dan merayu kemaafan daripada Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Setelah berusaha, akhirnya Fariz berjaya mengajak Ainnura keluar. Fariz berterus terang yang dia masih sayangkan Ainnura. Ainnura serba salah kerana dia tahu yang Datuk Rashid mahu menjodohkan Fariz dengan anaknya, Rania. Dalam waktu yang sama, Datuk Rashid juga cuba mengeratkan hubungan Ainnura dengan Reza.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Tok Wan kurang senang apabila mengetahui Ainnura menjalin semula hubungan dengan Fariz. Dia mahu Ainnura putuskan hubungan dengan Fariz. Justeru, Tok Wan menyokong usaha Ilah untuk menjodohkan Ainnura dengan pemuda pilihan Ilah. Demi cintanya pada Ainnura, Fariz saggup berdepan dengan Tok Wan dalam usaha merayu Tok Wan agar merestui hubungan mereka berdua sebagaimana yang pernah Tok Wan lakukan enam tahun lalu.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Rania cuba menarik perhatian Fariz tetapi usahanya sia-sia. Akhirnya Rania menyerah kalah dan yakin cinta Fariz bukan miliknya. Bagaimanapun Datuk Rashid mendesak Rania supaya usaha lagi dan jangan mudah mengaku kalah. Dia mahu Fariz menjadi menantunya demi legasi syarikat mereka. Sementara itu, kesungguhan Fariz untuk mendapatkan semula Ainnura telah melembutkan hati Tok Wan. Dalam usaha membantu Fariz, Tok Wan sengaja merancangkan sesuatu untuk merapatkan hubungan Fariz dengan Ainnura dan Fawwaz.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Tindakan Tok Wan merapatkan hubungan Ainnura dengan Fariz menimbulkan kemarahan Ilah. Ilah tetap berkeras untuk jodohkan Ainnura dengan lelaki pilihannya. Apabila Ainnura tidak setuju dengan pilihan Ilah, Tok Wan sengaja membuat dalih untuk kahwinkan Ainnura dengan Aidel iaitu kawan rapat Ainnura, bukannya dengan Fariz. Sementara itu, Rohana sudah membayangkan akan bermenantukan anak Datuk apabila Datuk Rashid menjemputnya mereka makan tengah hari sambil berbincang dengan perkahwinan Rania dengan Fariz.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnura akhirnya bersedia untuk berkahwin dengan Fariz untuk kali kedua tetapi memberi syarat supaya Rohana sendiri yang meminangnya. Fariz juga tidak dibenarkan mempersoalkan siapa Fawwaz yang sebenarnya kerana Fawwaz bukan anak kandung Fariz sebagaimana yang disangkakan oleh Fariz. Beberapa hari sebelum pernikahan Ainnura dan Fariz, Tok Wan meninggal dunia akibat terjatuh di bilik air.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123
programme.desc: Umai dan Icha masih cuba untuk memahami Oya yang kelihatan sentiasa memberontak. Pian risau kerana orang yang selalu membulinya di masa lalu kini muncul kembali.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Setelah berusaha, akhirnya Fariz berjaya mengajak Ainnura keluar. Fariz berterus terang yang dia masih sayangkan Ainnura. Ainnura serba salah kerana dia tahu yang Datuk Rashid mahu menjodohkan Fariz dengan anaknya, Rania. Dalam waktu yang sama, Datuk Rashid juga cuba mengeratkan hubungan Ainnura dengan Reza.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Tok Wan kurang senang apabila mengetahui Ainnura menjalin semula hubungan dengan Fariz. Dia mahu Ainnura putuskan hubungan dengan Fariz. Justeru, Tok Wan menyokong usaha Ilah untuk menjodohkan Ainnura dengan pemuda pilihan Ilah. Demi cintanya pada Ainnura, Fariz saggup berdepan dengan Tok Wan dalam usaha merayu Tok Wan agar merestui hubungan mereka berdua sebagaimana yang pernah Tok Wan lakukan enam tahun lalu.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Selepas kematian Tok Wan, Ilah berhasrat untuk membatalkan perkahwinan Ainnura dengan Fariz. Bagaimanapun Ainnura bertegas untuk meneruskan rancangan mereka kerana itu juga yang dimahukan oleh Tok Wan demi meliah keluarga Ainnura dan keluarga Fariz berdamai. Rohana menyokong keputusan Ainnura dan ini menyebabkan Ilah kecil hati dengan Ainnura. Ilah akhirnya tidak hadir pada hari perkahwinan Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Sikap prihatin dan baik Rohana terhadap Ainnura akhirnya terbongkar apabila tujuan Rohana merestui hasrat Fariz untuk megahwini Ainnura hanyalah semata-mata untuk membalas dendam pada Ainnura. Rohana paksa Ainnura tinggal bersamanya dan jika Ainnura menujuk Fariz supaya keluar dari rumah tersebut, dia tidak halal susu yang diminum oleh Fariz serta menganggap Fariz anak derhaka. Sementara itu, dalam diam Ilah sebenarnya merindui Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Rohana sengaja menyeksa fizikal dan mental Ainnura. Fazira melihat apa yang dilakukan oleh Rohana terhadap Ainnura lalu mendesak Ainnura dan Fariz keluar dari rumah tersebut. Bagaimanapun Ainnura enggan kerana tidak mahu Fariz dianggap sebagai anak derhaka. Gara-hara terlalu marah dengan Ainnura, Rohana telah menghentak kepala Ainnura ke dinding. Fariz perasan dengan bengkak di kepala Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnura berbohong dengan Fariz yang bengkak di kepalanya akiat terhantuk pada sinki. Dalam waktu yang sama, Rohana mendakwa Ainnura sengaja menolaknya sehinggakan dia hampir terjatuh. Fateha menyokong kata-kata Rohana, menyebabkan Fariz keliru siapakah yang benar di antara isteri dan ibunya. Ainnura bangkit mempertahankan haknya. Selain daripada Ainnura, Fawwaz turut menjadi mangsa Rohana dan Fateha dengan pelbagai penghinaan sehingga akhirnya kerana tidak sanggup melihat Fawwaz dihina, Fazira mengakui yang Fawwaz adalah anaknya.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Fateha dan Rohana terkejut apabila mengetahui Fawwaz adalah anak Fazira hasil hubungan terlarang dengan Raja Azali iaitu kekasih Fateha. Pada mulanya mereka tidak percaya tetapi ketika mereka hendak mendapatkan penjelasan daripada Raja Azali, Raja Azali telah ditangkap polis atas beberapa tuduhan merogol. Fariz meminta maaf di atas sikap Rohana selama ini. Ainnura telah lama memaafkan Rohana tetapi mahu Fariz menceraikannya kerana dia tidak mahu Fariz menjadi anak derhaka gara-garanya. Rohana terharu dengan sikap baik Ainnura dan merayu kemaafan daripada Ainnura.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. However, when mafioso Calbone’s henchmen catch up with Mike and Armen, determined to drag them back to New York to pay for their crimes, Max has everything to lose. Teaming up with his old friend, Marseille Mafia crime boss, Paul, Max hatches a plan to lure the New York Mafia to Mayfair.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: During WWII, the American army have raced their way through the countryside on the border of France entering Nazi Germany. Hitler has deployed his secret weapon. Lieutenant Frank Ross encounters the Nazi weapon and an intense aerial battle ensues.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Hayes Hodges, an attorney, takes up the offer of defending his friend Colonel Terry Childers, accused of ordering his squad to open fire on a group of demonstrators.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Project Legion
programme.desc: A young man trapped in his apartment with a swarm of demons outside his door must find a way to survive the night and escape from apartment 213.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.desc: Despite J.T.’s efforts to change his fate and the cooperation of Sikorski, the clock ticks inexorably towards J.T.’s demise. Carl, convinced that J.T’s survival will imperil the universe, is frantically working to make sure that he meets his destiny. Brad has armed himself with a hunting rifle, determined to retrieve the briefcase he believes will make him rich. When J.T. returns to his home with Sikorski, they find that the two cops assigned to guard the house have been knocked out and someone has taken Claudia and Jesse hostage. They soon learn that Roy Bremmer’s lawyer had his client released from custody hours earlier.

After a fun day, it's time to have a clean-up dance party!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Get ready to learn with JJ! Embark on a musical journey that starts with the 'ABC Song,' making it fun to learn every letter. It's a fun-filled lesson that makes learning feel like a game.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's time to explore Earth and nature! A frog ballerina shows Ella that rain can be fun and is important for the farm. Plus, watch a caterpillar turn into a butterfly and learn some yoga moves with Rishi's mom.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for some singing fun at Lellobee City Farm! Learn your ABCs in the Boogie Barn and then learn how to wash your hands before eating some delicious dumplings. programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Get ready to sing, play and learn! The friends turn cleaning up into a fun time by forming a pots and pans band. They learn that more cooks in the kitchen make for a tastier breakfast and go on a pirate adventure in the bathtub.

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Get ready for an Animal Time Sing Along! JJ and his friends work together to get a boat to an island full of apples and bananas. Plus, JJ puts on a show for all his animal friends and learns how to be a pirate.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a day of nursery rhyme adventures with his animal friends. First, help Mary find her little lamb, then sing about a black sheep with lots of wool. programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's time to get out and about! The family has a fun day exploring the mall and the amusement park, learning how to be safe along the way. They dive into an underwater adventure and have a fun day at the beach. Jill opens her own beauty salon and the family goes on a pirate adventure. Plus, Baby John gets his eyes checked at the doctor.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Let's do what the animals do! The kids get their faces painted and pretend to be their favorite animals. At the zoo, they learn about which animals are loud and which are quiet. programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is a wonderful place! Join Blippi Wonders as he learns about creatures of all shapes and sizes. programme.title: Blippi Wonders

It's a fun-filled story about sportsmanship, rivalry, and pulling out all the stops to win.

programme.title: ARPO

Along the way, they'll deal with pesky squirrels and mysterious noises. These stories are all about friendship, problem-solving, and having fun together.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt tackles some weighty issues when the fattest parrot he has ever seen pays him a visit, in the sixth programme of the series Matt conducts an emergency caesarean to save the life of Penny the cat, and helps a swan which has been the victim of a brutal mugging.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: What items should a novice cat owner prepare to welcome their cat home? Recommendation of the best breeds for beginners among all cute cats! Eat like a champion cat by following healthy recipes we reveal! Don’t be afraid if you have a destructive cat at home, a trainer will help you understand your cat’s out-of-control behavior, Angelic Cat Training Class has begin! When the owner goes on a trip, felines will have a great vacation at the cat hotel!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: This programme finds Dr. Matt battling to fix a greyhound's broken leg to get it back on the track. We meet Matt's wife, Claire, a horse vet, who uses the latest technology to treat three troubled racehorses. But down on the farm Matt finds the old-fashioned way is best when it comes to finding out if a cow is pregnant.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner. The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate. Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series. programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: Doing Brunch Right, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill brings big brunch vibes with her favorite weekend dishes including NY-style bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich with black pepper bacon, Maryland-style Old Bay crab cake benedict, coquito French toast bites, and a berry-ful Aperol spritz!

programme.title: Tacos and Margaritas, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill hosts a heavenly girls night in, complete with sweet potato tacos with roasted corn salsa, carne asada tacos with orange & spice, and crab and shrimp enchiladas with chili verde. She tops it all off with a fabulous margarita station.

programme.title: Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers.

programme.title: Tacos, Brats, & Biscuits in Austin
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes down south to try Austin’s best bets - breakfast tacos are on the itinerary, as well as a bangin’ beer garden & sausage house, loaded biscuits, and dessert pancakes to boot! Austin may be weird but the food is fabulous.

programme.title: Brooklyn’s Best Pizza Tour
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes on the best pizza party crawl that Brooklyn has to offer. He’ll try a Neo-Neapolitan pie, a classic coal oven favorite, he’ll hit up a modern joint with innovative toppings, and a cozy Italian-owned neighborhood spot.

programme.title: BBQ Bowls & Puffy Tacos in San Antonio
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza gets his spurs on to sample San Antonio’s best all-day brunch, taste some epic puffy tacos at a classic car joint, create colorful conchitas, and bask in the beauty of BBQ Thai curry bowls.

programme.title: Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar.

programme.title: Healthy Meals!
programme.desc: On this episode, we're going to show you why eating healthy can still be delicious and enjoyable! Join us for a Tastemade Recipe Rundown of some of our favorite healthy meals!

programme.title: Meat Lovers!
programme.desc: On this episode, we serve up our favorite meat-themed recipes! From chicken, to pork and steak, meat lovers everywhere are in for a treat!

programme.title: All About the Bread!
programme.desc: On this episode, we explore some of our favorite bread-themed recipes and learn some fun facts about each dish along the way! From breakfast, to lunch and dinner, your next dish to try at home is just around the corner!

programme.title: Dinner Party!
programme.desc: On this episode, we're throwing a Tastemade dinner party, and everyone's invited! From appetizers to desserts, we share some of our favorite dinner party recipes for you to try at home!

programme.title: Dishes of the World!
programme.desc: On this episode, we take a trip around the world and spotlight some of our favorite recipes from Europe, Asia and Africa. Grab your passport and get ready for a tasty trip!

programme.title: Comfort Food!
programme.desc: On this episode, it's time to get cozy with some of our favorite Tastemade comfort food recipes. Get cozy and settle in for what's sure to be a mouth-watering journey!

programme.title: European Adventure
programme.desc: Today, we embark on a European Adventure! We'll be visiting the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and Greece to check out their culinary wonders. So what are we waiting for? Let's get to it!

programme.title: Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: When the cold and snowy season descends upon us, it's only fitting you'll want some delicious, home-cooked food to warm you up. Good thing we're taking a trip through our Winter Wonderland today! So toss aside those mittens... it's time to cook!

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents
programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Over the Top Holiday Cakes
programme.desc: Mia Starr gives a crash course in her all-time favorite, most used decorating techniques. From piping styles to watercolor frosting to maximalist designs, she teaches the basics of holiday cake decorating, in her own signature style.

programme.title: Hack Your Holidays
programme.desc: In this episode, you don’t even need to turn on your oven! From a jaw-dropping cake hack, to fried biscuit donuts, you won’t believe what you can do with pre-made desserts from the supermarket. Mia will show hacks and great tips for any home-baker!

programme.title: Weeknight Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten cooks up a collection of easy and satisfying pasta dishes quick enough for weeknights. Don't Panic!

programme.title: Grilling and Smoking
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten grills up a perfect yet simple burger topped with cheddar, lettuce, onion and his 'special sauce'. Don't Panic!

programme.title: Christmas Special
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten celebrates Christmas with his twist on the traditional "Feast of the Seven Fishes" including ceviche, crudo, oysters and more! Don't Panic!

programme.title: Grandmas Pizza
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten cooks classic Grandma style pizza including homemade dough, sauce and more. Don't Panic!

programme.title: A Journey to Salad Town
programme.desc: Salads can be way more fun! Come to Salad Town, for Mustard-Shallot Vinaigrette; Probiotic Ranch with Cheddar Croutons; a no-measure salad when for when you’re in a rush; and the crunchy, crispy, acidic, cheesy, Chopped Salad of your dreams.

programme.title: Rustic Comfort Pastas
programme.desc: Perfect Pantry Puttanesca is packed with more flavor than you could ever hope for; a Rustic Pork Ragu will make you wonder why anyone ever makes Bolognese: and a Vegetarian Mushroom Ragu will make you wonder why anyone ever eats meat.

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Summer Seafood Smorgasbord
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don’t you dare miss this beach party!

programme.title: Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde prepares a finger food feast with char grilled chili crab, spiced adobo potatoes, grilled pork belly, & sofrito stuffed branzino all served on a bed of rice over banana leaves. Call your friends - this is a feast that will feed many!

programme.title: Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin’ banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: Pizzapalooza
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is throwin’ down a pizza spread like never before with his Chicago-style tavern pie with sausage & onion, a grilled pizza pocket with pepperoni & cheese, chicken wings a la pizzaiola, and a zesty grilled caesar salad to finish it off.

programme.title: Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: Top of the Line Steaks
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is back to level up his steak game by grilling up a NY strip steak with roasted onions & poblanos, short ribs with chili paste and horseradish, and a grilled chateaubriand with charred broccolini. Steak your claim on these dishes!

programme.title: Family-Friendly BBQ

programme.title: Grilled Chicken 3 Ways
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

programme.title: The Perfection of Pork
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.

programme.title: Tempting Tasty Tacos

programme.title: Breakfast for Dinner

programme.desc: It’s time to get warm and fire up some soup. Pantry Minestrone makes a veggie-loaded comfort soup using almost entirely canned or frozen pantry ingredients. We’re also going to show you how to make a beautiful homemade chicken stock.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Special
programme.desc: Noah walks us through making his Smoked Turkey Gravy recipe. Get a jump start on Thanksgiving and make your stock in advance! Saving yourself the headache the day of.

programme.title: Meat Lovers!
programme.desc: On this episode, we serve up our favorite meat-themed recipes! From chicken, to pork and steak, meat lovers everywhere are in for a treat!

programme.title: All About the Bread!
programme.desc: On this episode, we explore some of our favorite bread-themed recipes and learn some fun facts about each dish along the way! From breakfast, to lunch and dinner, your next dish to try at home is just around the corner!

programme.title: Dinner Party!
programme.desc: On this episode, we're throwing a Tastemade dinner party, and everyone's invited! From appetizers to desserts, we share some of our favorite dinner party recipes for you to try at home!

programme.title: Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: When the cold and snowy season descends upon us, it's only fitting you'll want some delicious, home-cooked food to warm you up. Good thing we're taking a trip through our Winter Wonderland today! So toss aside those mittens... it's time to cook!

programme.title: Dishes of the World!
programme.desc: On this episode, we take a trip around the world and spotlight some of our favorite recipes from Europe, Asia and Africa. Grab your passport and get ready for a tasty trip!

programme.title: Latin Lovers... Of Food!
programme.desc: On this episode, we take a trip down to South America as we feature some of our favorite Latin-inspired recipes for you to try at home!

programme.title: European Adventure
programme.desc: Today, we embark on a European Adventure! We'll be visiting the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and Greece to check out their culinary wonders. So what are we waiting for? Let's get to it!

programme.title: Healthy Meals!
programme.desc: On this episode, we're going to show you why eating healthy can still be delicious and enjoyable! Join us for a Tastemade Recipe Rundown of some of our favorite healthy meals!

programme.title: Sweet and Savory!
programme.desc: On this episode, we're serving up something for sweet and savory lovers alike. Opposites will attract and stomachs will grumble in this sweet and savory Recipe Rundown!

programme.title: Cheat Day!
programme.desc: On this episode, we help you splurge with some of our favorite breakfast, lunch and dinner "cheat day" recipes! No calorie counting allowed!

programme.title: Summer BBQ
programme.desc: Summer is coming to a close but there’s still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that’ll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill.

programme.title: Bring Your Own Lunch
programme.desc: Frankie is all about BYOL - bring your own lunch. It’s not only good for your wallet, it’s good for your health. Skip the vending machine and the cafeteria in favor of creative, cost effective and easy-to-transport midday meals.

programme.title: Salad Salad Salad
programme.desc: Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

programme.title: How Do You Like Them Apples
programme.desc: Apples aren’t just good for keeping the doctor away. Frankie demonstrates how to make the most of this beloved, everyday fruit, from sweet treats to savory meals. There’s a whole world of apples to dive into, especially while they’re in season.

programme.title: Super Squash
programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of squash: they’re affordable, abundant and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

programme.title: Spooktacular Tricks and Treats
programme.desc: Don’t let the line of trick-or-treaters or the candy corn overload scare you out of the kitchen this Halloween. Frankie’s got tricks up his sleeve to make simple yet wicked good treats for everyone at the party to enjoy. All while saving some dough.

programme.title: Let's Play Ball
programme.desc: Batter up! Fall ball is heating up, and Frankie’s offering us his favorite stadium snacks, without those major league prices. No matter who you’re rooting for, these ballpark classics will be a hit with friends and family for seasons to come.

programme.title: The Future is Flavor
programme.desc: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that’ll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Oktoberfest
programme.desc: Join Frankie as he shares his budget friendly takes on Oktoberfest-inspired dishes, perfect for celebrating the fall season with friends. These festive and hearty meals will keep you cozy and full, and best of all, pair nicely with a beer.

programme.title: We Knead Pizza
programme.desc: Cancel the pizza delivery, it’s time to save money and build your pies from scratch. With three different pizza styles, you’re bound to find one that satisfies your craving without digging into your wallet.

programme.title: Grubby Good Food
programme.desc: Send your taste buds on a first class food tour without even leaving the Struggle kitchen! Frankie whips up his favorite regional specialties from five destinations, making them as authentic as possible while sticking to his budget.

programme.title: Sweater Weather
programme.desc: The air is crisp and the leaves are changing, which means it’s time to gather ‘round the dinner table for hearty, seasonal meals on a budget. These warm dishes are sure to keep you cozy all season long.

programme.title: Meals Under $7
programme.desc: At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price!

programme.title: Pizza Slice, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill throws a pizza party with her delicious homemade pies! She creates a sweet and savory pie with spicy pepperoni & pineapple, a tangy BBQ chicken pizza, a grandma deep dish pie with mozzarella & chorizo, and an herby salad flatbread.

programme.title: Plantains and Rice, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month with her mom’s recipes as well as some of her own. She’ll whip up a coconut coquito cocktail, Cuban-style black beans, a garlicky arroz con pollo with sofrito, and some salty and sweet plantains.

programme.title: Moroccan Lamb with Sangria, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill welcomes the coziness of fall with some fabulous flavors & dishes including Moroccan lamb with dates & harissa, fall sangria with apples & amaretto, garlicky rice pilaf, roasted root vegetables, and crispy cucumber salad. It’s fall y’all!

programme.title: Doing Brunch Right, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill brings big brunch vibes with her favorite weekend dishes including NY-style bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich with black pepper bacon, Maryland-style Old Bay crab cake benedict, coquito French toast bites, and a berry-ful Aperol spritz!

programme.title: Tacos and Margaritas, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill hosts a heavenly girls night in, complete with sweet potato tacos with roasted corn salsa, carne asada tacos with orange & spice, and crab and shrimp enchiladas with chili verde. She tops it all off with a fabulous margarita station.

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill
programme.desc: It’s Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po’boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.

programme.title: Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it’s Sunday somewhere, right?

programme.title: Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers.

programme.title: Tacos, Brats, & Biscuits in Austin
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes down south to try Austin’s best bets - breakfast tacos are on the itinerary, as well as a bangin’ beer garden & sausage house, loaded biscuits, and dessert pancakes to boot! Austin may be weird but the food is fabulous.

programme.title: Brooklyn’s Best Pizza Tour
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes on the best pizza party crawl that Brooklyn has to offer. He’ll try a Neo-Neapolitan pie, a classic coal oven favorite, he’ll hit up a modern joint with innovative toppings, and a cozy Italian-owned neighborhood spot.

programme.title: BBQ Bowls & Puffy Tacos in San Antonio
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza gets his spurs on to sample San Antonio’s best all-day brunch, taste some epic puffy tacos at a classic car joint, create colorful conchitas, and bask in the beauty of BBQ Thai curry bowls.

programme.title: Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar.

programme.title: Garden of Treasure
programme.desc: Buckle up as Darren takes us back on the road in this new season! Join him as he discovers herb gardens filled with treasures across Malaysia's farms & markets - and scales the mountains of East Malaysia, searching for the medicinal herbs used by the aboriginal people & local Chinese.

programme.title: Taste Selebriti
programme.desc: A food-travelogue program where 13 local celebrities will return to their hometowns to share traditional cuisines, unique foods and popular dishes in their states.

programme.title: Travel Lawak
programme.desc: Sebuah program travelog yang menampilkan tiga pelawak popular iaitu Syuk, Sharif Zero dan Mamak Puteh di mana mereka akan mengembara ke luar negara dan meneroka sendiri budaya dan tempat-tempat menarik.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E09 - Bear
programme.desc: Laramy hunts for spring black bear in the Rocky Mountains with his Hawken rifle. Learn some skinning techniques and uses of black bear meat, fur, and fat.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E03 - One Rhino at a Time
programme.desc: While visiting a secret orphanage that cares for rescued baby rhinos, Ivan discovers the blood, sweat, tears that goes into saving this endangered species. An emergency phone call sends him on an adventure with a group of local heroes to save the next newly orphaned rhino.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E01 - Dangerous on Land
programme.desc: This episode offers an exciting look at nature with close-ups of wild cats, snakes, crocodiles, scorpions, etc., focusing on the animals' methods of defense or predation (venom, teeth, claws, size, etc.). In this episode you will learn all about the wild world of dangerous animals.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E02 - Fastest
programme.desc: The fastest? The explosive sprinting cheetah? The mighty kangaroo? The horned and leaping wildebeest? The powerful and sure-footed horse? Or the swift-footed pronghorn? Which is the fastest over land?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E03 - Biggest
programme.desc: The Biggest? An Elephant? A Giraffe? A Hippopotamus? Or the humpback whale which is three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighs more than a dozen hippos. But which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E04 - Smartest
programme.desc: Are animals smart? You bet. But which is the smartest of them all? The socially complex chimpanzee? The inventive bolas spider? The architectural termite? The curious dolphin? Or the inimitable octopus?

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E11 - Naturally Different
programme.desc: The Shetland Islands: home to 20,000 humans, one million birds and the smallest horse in the world. Then on to an area known to the locals as the Centre of the World in South Eastern province of Kazakhstan. From there we will go to the Yellow Mountains in Central China often called The Venice of China.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E12 - Naturally Vibrant
programme.desc: South Moravia in the Czech Republic is home to a wide variety of beautiful orchids. From there we go to the Caribbean to Cuba with its unbelievably beautiful vistas contrasted with brutal cock fighting. From Cuba we travel to Fiji in the Pacific Ocean – often considered to be a true paradise on Earth.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E06 - Trapping Show
programme.desc: Laramy honors the history of the mountain man by trapping for beaver in the lower rockies.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: Reflecting on Diana's legacy, this show delves into what Princess Diana left behind after her sudden passing - the impression she left on her children, the royal family, and the people who loved her. The young princes drew admiration with their demeanor at her funeral, but many questioned how their bond with Prince Charles would be moving forward.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E03 - Operation Yellowstone
programme.desc: In Region 5, wardens ride a jet boat up the Yellowstone River, keeping an eye on fly fishing guides and stumbling upon a boat mishap. After that, they head to Region 1 for some shooting practice.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E04 - Operation Antelope Dummy
programme.desc: With the number of Pronghorn antelopes dropping, the Wardens in Region 7 set up a decoy sting right before the season kicks off, but the major issue turns out to be people trespassing on opening day. Meanwhile, Region 4 Warden Bryan Golie gets a call about a possible poaching incident.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E06 - Exploration Camp
programme.desc: The guys continue to push down river. Exhausted and starving, the brothers have barely enough energy to set camp. The guys discover is that sign is plentiful and the topography lends itself to moose habitat.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E07 - Prayer Point
programme.desc: By the third day of moving along the river, everyone really needed a hunting camp to lift their spirits and keep pushing towards the goal of taking down a big bull. Tensions ran high and for the first time, the brothers confessed they were at a loss on how to proceed.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space
programme.desc: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E02 - Atmosphere
programme.desc: Climate change and pollution are having dire consequences for the atmosphere of our planet, this episode updates the latest technology and science looking into the health of our air.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E05 - Delta Prison Rescue Operation
programme.desc: In 1989, CIA operative Kurt Muse was imprisoned at the notorious Carcel Modelo in Panama for his role in organizing radio transmissions against dictator Manuel Noriega. That December, an elite group of the US Delta Force breached the roof of the prison, and one of the most daring close quarter battle operations in history began. From the dramatic helicopter crash and wounding of several Delta operators to the extraction of the entire team by the 5th Infantry Division, this is prime material for CQB analysis. In this episode, CQB recreates the raid, focusing on the "sub-second" reflexes of the Delta Force team from the moment they entered the prison to their extraction from the roof of the prison by an MH-6 "Little Bird" helicopter.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E06 - Snipers and Scout
programme.desc: Joint Task Force Two (JTF 2) is the elite Canadian Forces Special Operations unit responsible for a broad range of missions, including counter-terrorism and armed assistance to other government departments. Highly secretive, JTF 2 and its predecessor, the Canadian Airborne Regiment, have been deployed in hotspots around the world from Haiti to Bosnia. This episode focuses on the legendary JTF sniper teams and their use in Afghanistan alongside the British SAS and the US Delta Force at "the sharp end of the spear." A book written by an ex-JTF member explains how, in 2006, both the Pentagon and the British Foreign Office noted the instrumental role that JTF 2 played in the rescue of the British and Canadian Christian Peacemaker Team held hostage in Iraq. Unique in look, the FN P90 personal defense weapon, used by JTF 2 soldiers and special police around the world, will be highlighted in this program.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E02 - Meateaters
programme.desc: Papua New Guinea Pt2. Jim brings meat to the local village while Corey explores leech infested swamps looking for the local deer. Local villagers tell Jim of a remote area 400 miles away where buffalo roam.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: This show offers a captivating look into the extraordinary life of one of the 20th century's most fascinating women, seen through an American lens. It features clips from the auction where her dresses were sold.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E05 - Operation Cascade
programme.desc: The Upper Missouri River is a top spot for trout fishing and rafting. In Region 4's Cascade district, there's a buzz around a strange camper on private property. In Region 7, they're busy doing water safety inspections.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E06 - Operation Blackfoot
programme.desc: Wardens in Region 2 are checking out a Tip Mont report about several elk down in an area known for grizzlies. When they get there, one elk and the suspect aren't around. Meanwhile, wardens in Region 7 are dealing with gunfire during a decoy sting operation.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E08 - King Of The Tundra
programme.desc: Casey sees a huge bull on the other side of the river and takes it down about 10 yards from the water. Then, another bull comes up the river towards the fallen one. Casey and this bull face off, staring each other down from opposite sides of the river.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E09 - The Day After
programme.desc: After taking down a huge bull, Chris and Casey manage to cut up the 1500-pound moose just as night is about to set in. They then set up a meat storage solution to keep the food good for the rest of their trip.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status
programme.desc: The latest updates on The New space hardware about to launch us into the next generation of space flight some rockets and capsules are on time others not so fortunate.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E04 - Invasion Mars
programme.desc: The EXO Mars and Curiosity continue their scientific discoveries as we prepare The New missions both robotic and manned to the Red planet Mars.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E07 - S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: In 1968, a new form of military policing was being developed in a rural area north of Los Angeles. The Los Angeles Police Department sent an observer to this unit, and he, in turn, took this knowledge back to the LAPD. This contributed to the development of the department’s first Special Weapons and Tactics (S.W.A.T.) team. This CQB episode takes an historical journey to examine how this incident affected and changed police tactics around the world. Using CQB’s trademark "sub-second" analysis, the program also looks at how police S.W.A.T. teams train, plan and equip themselves for the challenges of urban combat. The dramatization of a 1980s S.W.A.T. siege of a gang safe-house demonstrates the complicated challenge of protecting innocent people who might be caught in the line of fi re, as well as the specifics of the squad’s training regimen, how they communicated, and the special equipment they used.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E08 - Hunting Sarajevo Snipers
programme.desc: The Bosnian War was an extraordinarily complex event, with many layers of military involvement including NATO forces, national militaries, irregular paramilitary forces, mujahedeen revolutionaries, private security companies, and international intelligence personnel. One tactic in particular struck fear into the hearts of the military and civilians alike: the use of snipers positioned in high buildings. This edition of CQB investigates this specific combat technique and how it was countered by opposing forces. Taking viewers inside a "sniper‘s den," the program explains how this tactic was so successfully used by rebel forces – and how traditional military techniques evolved to combat it.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E03 - End Game
programme.desc: Papua New Guinea Pt3. Jim and Corey split up and search for buffalo. Jim, unable to reach Corey by radio, hears several shots from Corey's direction and heads out to search for his friend.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E11 - Royal Children Prince William and Prince Harry
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

The dramatization of a 1980s S.W.A.T. siege of a gang safe-house demonstrates the complicated challenge of protecting innocent people who might be caught in the line of fi re, as well as the specifics of the squad’s training regimen, how they communicated, and the special equipment they used.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E08 - Hunting Sarajevo Snipers
programme.desc: The Bosnian War was an extraordinarily complex event, with many layers of military involvement including NATO forces, national militaries, irregular paramilitary forces, mujahedeen revolutionaries, private security companies, and international intelligence personnel. One tactic in particular struck fear into the hearts of the military and civilians alike: the use of snipers positioned in high buildings. This edition of CQB investigates this specific combat technique and how it was countered by opposing forces. Taking viewers inside a "sniper‘s den," the program explains how this tactic was so successfully used by rebel forces – and how traditional military techniques evolved to combat it.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E03 - End Game
programme.desc: Papua New Guinea Pt3. Jim and Corey split up and search for buffalo. Jim, unable to reach Corey by radio, hears several shots from Corey's direction and heads out to search for his friend.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E11 - Royal Children Prince William and Prince Harry
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: This show offers a captivating look into the extraordinary life of one of the 20th century's most fascinating women, seen through an American lens. It features clips from the auction where her dresses were sold.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E05 - Operation Cascade
programme.desc: The Upper Missouri River is a top spot for trout fishing and rafting. In Region 4's Cascade district, there's a buzz around a strange camper on private property. In Region 7, they're busy doing water safety inspections.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E06 - Operation Blackfoot
programme.desc: Wardens in Region 2 are checking out a Tip Mont report about several elk down in an area known for grizzlies. When they get there, one elk and the suspect aren't around. Meanwhile, wardens in Region 7 are dealing with gunfire during a decoy sting operation.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E08 - King Of The Tundra
programme.desc: Casey sees a huge bull on the other side of the river and takes it down about 10 yards from the water. Then, another bull comes up the river towards the fallen one. Casey and this bull face off, staring each other down from opposite sides of the river.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E09 - The Day After
programme.desc: After taking down a huge bull, Chris and Casey manage to cut up the 1500-pound moose just as night is about to set in. They then set up a meat storage solution to keep the food good for the rest of their trip.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E04 - Invasion Mars

programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E07 - Operation Spotted Dog
programme.desc: Working to protect our treasured natural resources in some of the country's most secluded spots means there's never a boring day on the job.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E08 - Operation Boat Float
programme.desc: In the shade of the wild mountains, the Yellowstone River transforms into a colorful spectacle during the yearly boat float weekend. Armed with jet boats, the Wardens gear up for a wild time, looking out for the river and helping out the wacky rafters.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E10 - Return Home
programme.desc: Casey’s bull disappeared downstream quickly, heading into uncharted waters the brothers hadn’t explored yet. They’re eager to see what happens next.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E05 - Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Cassini space craft has completed its mission over Saturn, Juno has reached its target and has commenced its scientific observations of the giant planet Jupiter. and The New Horizons speeds on it its next encounter at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E06 - Sling Shot
programme.desc: Sending probes throughout the solar system is a mathematicians dream and an engineers nightmare, sling shotting probes around other planets to arrive at their destination, we checkout the latest probes about to slingshot about the solar system.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors
programme.desc: The practice of hiring private armies goes back to ancient times, and the mystique associated with the mercenary warrior has been the subject of many historical studies and fictional characterizations. This episode of CQB takes a more contemporary look at a day in the life of a group of civilian contractors, and how their role has evolved on the modern battlefield. Using its "sub-second" analysis techniques and intimate first-person footage, CQB reveals the backgrounds, training and equipment of today’s "soldiers for hire" and how private armies are re-shaping the way conflicts are conducted around the world.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection
programme.desc: From the elite ex-special forces personnel in charge of guarding heads of state in conflict zones to the two-person teams that protect CEOs in dangerous regions, modern day bodyguards must be well versed in close quarter battle techniques. An immense amount of planning and preparation is involved in each operation. From air travel, car convoys and helicopter shuttles to basic foot traffic, a close protection squad must be completely tuned to the Who, What, Where and When of any given situation. This episode of CQB focuses on the complex day-to-day and minute-to-minute operations of these elite teams and the highly developed techniques they employ.

From air travel, car convoys and helicopter shuttles to basic foot traffic, a close protection squad must be completely tuned to the Who, What, Where and When of any given situation. This episode of CQB focuses on the complex day-to-day and minute-to-minute operations of these elite teams and the highly developed techniques they employ.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E11 - Counter Terrorism
programme.desc: Following the September 11 attacks, military presence became commonplace in New York and other American cities, and the counter terrorism forces were effectively given a "blank cheque" when it came to ensuring that another terrorist incident would never take place on American soil. This episode of CQB takes an in–depth look at who was selected to occupy elite anti-terrorist positions, what they were trained for, and how they were equipped: when opposing forces are using commercial airliners and chemical weapons, countermeasures are by necessity complicated and varied. CQB takes an intimate look at what it was like to be an officer on alert for chemical attacks in Washington DC, or an army reservist monitoring suspicious activities on the streets of NYC.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E12 - French Foreign Legion
programme.desc: No country other than France operates an elite military force that invites foreign nationals to serve in its ranks. With a reputation for being a safe haven for individuals with questionable pasts, the French Foreign Legion is a true mercenary army that has garnered significant respect within the global special operations community. This episode of CQB examines a raid by the Foreign Legion on a small airport in Iraq during the 1990 Gulf War, exploring the nature of the Legion, how it differs from other special forces, and how it prepares for a wide variety of close quarter battle scenarios in conflict situations around the world.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E04 - Elephant Country
programme.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers who have been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E05 - Strongest
programme.desc: How do you decide which is the strongest animal on the Planet? Wild Ones looks at the comparative strength of the tiniest of ants to that of a might grizzly bear, or a deadly crocodile to the indestructible rhinoceros.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E06 - Cutest
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful butterfly. The cheerful clownfish. Or the adorable budgie - which one is the cutest of them all?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E07 - Wild Australia
programme.desc: More than 80 percent of Australia’s plants, mammals, reptiles and frogs are unique to Australia and are found nowhere else in the world. Wild dingos, frisky kangaroos, deceptively cuddly looking koalas and playful platypuses are some of the most iconic of Australia’s wild animals.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E08 - Masters of the Sky
programme.desc: So many words describe the many ways that birds fly – pelicans and kestrels soar but owls fly silently. Parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Radar-accurate eyes scan the ground and slotted feathers adjust flight paths as hawks attack. But, which is the true master of the sky?

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. Zambia was initially Northern Rhodesia and lies on the other bank of the river. Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in the south-east of Africa. It borders with South Africa to the south. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: We journey in search of incredible miracles of nature begins on the Canary Islands. Lanzarote is of a volcanic origin. Volcanic activity created a fantastical landscape, similar to that on Mars. On Gran Canarias we will witness a traditional harvest of a crop that has been brought to the rest of the world from here - sugarcane. We will wrap up this episode in the Moroccan province of Gulemin, a home to a nomadic tribe whose inseparable companions are camels.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E04 - Naturally Colourful
programme.desc: Venture into the Mexican seaside state of Veracruz in the south-west of the country and admire the unbelievable colours of locally grown orchids. Find out how vanilla is grown and discover how brown sugar is made. To top things off, witness an extraordinary ritual. Later, we will visit the Cayman Islands in the Caribbean. The three islands are relatively small but are inhabited by some remarkable animals including sea turtles, friendly rays and other types of fish as well as fascinating blue iguanas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E05 - Naturally Enigmatic
programme.desc: Today we will visit three remarkable nooks of Europe in search of miracles of nature. To begin with, we will venture into Austria's Salzburg region. An area that is famous for its Alps and Tauern mountains but also because it is the birth place of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. After that, we will move over to the south western outpost of the old continent, to Portugal's Algarve region. To conclude, we will admire Corsica, the French island of beauty.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E10 - Montana Whitetail
programme.desc: Laramy embraces the challeges presented when hunting Whitetail deer in Montana.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E11 - Moose
programme.desc: Laramy has spotted some huge moose, now he just needs to hope his Hawken shoots straight and true!

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E12 - Bear Part 2
programme.desc: The bigger the challenge, the bigger the reward as Laramy continues his hunt for bear in the Rockies.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E13 - Hunt of a Mountain Man
programme.desc: Laramy shows us how hunting was done in the mid 1800s by the Mountain Men, where unusual skills and stalking techniques were needed to survive throughout the winter. Harsh Winters were known as White Death to the Mountain Men.

On Gran Canarias we will witness a traditional harvest of a crop that has been brought to the rest of the world from here - sugarcane. We will wrap up this episode in the Moroccan province of Gulemin, a home to a nomadic tribe whose inseparable companions are camels.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E04 - Naturally Colourful
programme.desc: Venture into the Mexican seaside state of Veracruz in the south-west of the country and admire the unbelievable colours of locally grown orchids. Find out how vanilla is grown and discover how brown sugar is made. To top things off, witness an extraordinary ritual. Later, we will visit the Cayman Islands in the Caribbean. The three islands are relatively small but are inhabited by some remarkable animals including sea turtles, friendly rays and other types of fish as well as fascinating blue iguanas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E05 - Naturally Enigmatic
programme.desc: Today we will visit three remarkable nooks of Europe in search of miracles of nature. To begin with, we will venture into Austria's Salzburg region. An area that is famous for its Alps and Tauern mountains but also because it is the birth place of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. After that, we will move over to the south western outpost of the old continent, to Portugal's Algarve region. To conclude, we will admire Corsica, the French island of beauty.
